| **Conversation** |  |
| **Settings** |  |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Local upload** — pick a JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF from your computer; the plugin stores it under th"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"e harness home and serves it over a same-origin route (admitted only when the declared MIME, detecte"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"d signature and extension all agree).
- **Paste a URL** — drop an `http(s)` image link and press Ent"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"er.
- **In-panel live preview** — a preview surface at the top of the row renders the image + scrim "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"+ a frosted glass bubble; dragging any slider repaints it instantly. The card's box tracks the live "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"window ratio, so the crop it shows is the crop the backdrop paints.
- **Stepped sliders** — ratio co"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ntrols snap in **5% steps**, blur radii in 1/2px steps; dragging only repaints, **release commits** "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"(one write per gesture, no jank).
- **Five controls** — wallpaper opacity, readability scrim, panel "},{"id":"p9s9","text":"opacity, frosted-glass blur, and wallpaper blur.
- **Fit modes & framing** — `cover` (fill, crop) or"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" `contain` (whole image). Under `cover` the preview card is a **pan surface**: it can move the image"},{"id":"p9s11","text":" along the crop's slack axis (up/down when the art fills the width, left/right when it fills the hei"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"ght) with a four-way move cursor — drag, arrow keys (Shift for a coarse step), double-click or the r"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"ecenter chip. `contain` letterboxes and offers no pan; either way the card keeps tracking the window"},{"id":"p9s14","text":" ratio.
- **Theme-aware scrim** — the light theme uses a white veil (lifts the art so dark text keep"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"s contrast); the dark theme automatically switches to a black veil (dims the art so light text keeps"},{"id":"p9s16","text":" contrast).

this plugin no longer adapts to the pre-rc.1 kernels."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin is a standard out-of-tree dsh bundle, published on npm:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"From a local checkout (development):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"From a source checkout:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Or from git:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Restart to load it:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- The **settings row** lives in the official General settings section (`settings.general.item` slot)"},{"id":"p26s2","text":", next to the Appearance row. Its chrome uses only `--dsw-alias-*` design tokens (buttons / pills / "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"segmented control / slider track match the official shell); sliders are native `input[type=range]` w"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ith 5% / 1–2px steps and release-commit. The preview card's box is computed from the live window rat"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"io (shrinking and centering as a whole past a height cap), and the wallpaper framing is stored as no"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"rmalized 0..1 offsets mapped onto `object-position` — so one stored framing holds across every windo"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"w size and source.
- The plugin's own host routes (`/api/bg-wallpaper/*`: `settings`, `upload`, `ima"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"ge/<id>`) read/write the section and serve uploads with same-origin + size caps + MIME/signature che"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"cks + a path-escape fence. A custom route family is used because the api-proxy settings allowlist do"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"es not expose third-party namespaces over the settings RPC.
- The background is drawn as a fixed `z-"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"index:-2` wallpaper layer plus a `z-index:-1` scrim on `body`, toggled by the `data-dsh-bg` attribut"},{"id":"p26s12","text":"e; the scrim switches white/black by `data-ds-dark-theme` in the injected stylesheet. Frosted glass "},{"id":"p26s13","text":"is whitelist-scoped: only the whitelisted surfaces get `--dsw-*` surface-token overrides, while ever"},{"id":"p26s14","text":"ything else is painted by explicit `data-dsh-bg-glass`-gated rules carrying the FULL recipe (fill + "},{"id":"p26s15","text":"sheen + blur chain): the three chrome buttons, the plugin manager's Installed/Discover segmented swi"},{"id":"p26s16","text":"tcher (track + sliding indicator), the load-earlier history button, the composer dock family (agent "},{"id":"p26s17","text":"task strips TodoPanel / GoalBar / QueueDock and their takeover panels — approval, question, plan rev"},{"id":"p26s18","text":"iew — whose tokens turn translucent and need the blur added), the subagent lineage popover, the home"},{"id":"p26s19","text":" hero preview badge and the sidebar build badge — every other official token and reading surface (me"},{"id":"p26s20","text":"nus, dialogs, tooltips, toasts) stays untouched.
